text_block_list.text:
The right to compete in the Arima Kinen
is
decided by the popular vote of racing
fans.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her accomplishments in the
Classics,
Мэдзиро Райан has earned enough
votes to take
part in the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Senior-year Umamusume, including the
"Beast,"
Oguri Cap, will also be
competing in the
illustrious race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Intimidated by all the extraordinary
entrants she
will be facing, Мэдзиро Райан
heads off to the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
